decisions.statement: A kept root is swept when the process ends rather than when a test file ends.
A kept root is what more than one test file in a run reads.
The world kept roots are taken from is made the first time one is asked for.
A test names only the prefix the test wants.
The root and its sweeping are not its concern.

definition: the scratch root more than one test file in a run reads, swept when the run ends
